## About
Park Place Motorcars Dallas runs its service center at 6113 Lemmon Avenue, where we look after Mercedes-Benz cars and Sprinter vans. You can schedule service online, ask about Express Service, or order parts through our parts department.
Drivers rate us 4.6 on Google from 1279 reviews. Reviewers mention a team that answers questions in depth, help with a loaner car or a shuttle ride so they didn't have to wait around, and a car that came back fully checked over.

## Services
- Mercedes-Benz service: Maintenance and repair for your Mercedes-Benz, scheduled online or by phone.
- Express Service: Ask about Express Service when you book your visit.
- Recall service: Bring your car in for recall work and we'll take care of it.
- Sprinter service: Service appointments for Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans.
- Parts: Order Mercedes-Benz parts through our online parts order form.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book a service appointment?
A: Schedule online. You can keep it quick or choose all the details of your appointment.

Q: Can I get a loaner car?
A: Complimentary loaner vehicles are available for select services when extensive diagnostics and labor are needed. Ask us for details when you book.

Q: Is the service department open on Saturday?
A: Yes, the service department is open on Saturday.
